note: After a quoted segment's closing delimiter, only whitespace may appear before the next unescaped dot or the pair separator (Sec 5.3.3, 'Nothing may follow the closer within the same segment'). Here a second quoted segment ` "b"` follows the first `"a"` with only whitespace between them but no dot -- there is no form combining two quoted segments without a separating dot, so this is InvalidKey, the same category as quoted_trailing_content.ktav's `"a"b: 1`, just with a space and a second quote instead of a bare `b`.
